title: Understanding and Mitigating the Bias Inheritance in LLM-based Data Augmentation on Downstream Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through measuring accuracy disparities in profession biography classification, comparing selection rates for male versus female candidates in hiring recommendation tasks, and analyzing average predicted compensation differences in salary recommendation tasks.

Evaluated by measuring model performance on culturally specific classification tasks (e.g., hate speech, offensive language, and bias detection across Arabic, Chinese, Portuguese, and Spanish contexts) and analyzing the frequency of positive and negative adjectives in open-ended story generation about characters from these cultures.
